scope: Input and assay metadata only; not response-bearing training data.

evidence.condition_values: Primary supplement, SI 1.2.2, PDF pages 3-4; provenance/supplement_methods_excerpt.txt
evidence.source_condition_keys: Repository README hierarchy definitions and examples, verified against the actual keys in schema_inventory.json
evidence.strain_and_medium: Primary Methods; SI 1.1 and 1.2.1, PDF page 3
evidence.pair_channel_semantics: Repository README, figS19_two_colour_expts description; actual eight group keys in inventory_summary.json

baseline.percent_convention: The inspected text reports glucose percent without explicitly stating mass/volume convention; no conversion to absolute glucose molarity was made.
baseline.zero_definition: Zero added stressor denotes no declared supplementation, not an assay of zero total chemical content.

switch.time_reference: arrival of Cy5-labelled stress medium; actual times are switch-relative minutes
switch.normalized_only_nominal_grid: 2.5*(j-origin) minutes with one-based j; nominal annotation only, not measured timestamps or full-movie elapsed time
switch.export_window_note: The acquisition protocol's duration is not the same as the deposited time-window length. Use the actual time arrays and registered windows; do not invent missing frames.

rich_to_rich.interpretation: Actual no-declared-input-change media-switch challenge, not an assumed zero measured response or a pair of independent pre/post experiments.

observation.raw_localization: nucLoc = max5 / median; dimensionless fluorescence proxy
observation.intensity_calibration: No absolute fluorescence-to-molecule or fluorescence-to-kinase-activity calibration is supplied in the deposited fields.
observation.nucLocNorm_reference: SI 3.1, PDF page 6; linked normMeanOffset.m:7-10 uses the mean of per-frame cell means and mean of per-frame sample SDs over 1-based columns origin-21:origin-2, not a pooled cell-time SD.
observation.conditional_prefix_note: A fixed normalizer of a known pre-stimulus prefix can be a legitimate calibration input for a newly registered post-stimulus conditional estimand. The full published example interpolates/inpaints whole traces and filters using the origin frame, so that entire pipeline is not automatically prefix-only. Original protocol restrictions are unchanged.
observation.null_policy: Preserve as missing; never impute as zero. Published inpainting was executed only for private identity replay, not authorized as learner preprocessing.
observation.row_pairing_policy: Use source-supported same-experiment row/time pairing, including genuine two-colour factors or raw and independent-mask-derived readouts within the marker experiment. Do not join separate single-colour strains or count measurement channels as biological replicates.
